dateFrom.title: From date
dateFrom.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or today, yesterday, tomorrow, or a day offset like -3 or +2. Live scores and serve stats cover 7 days back to 7 ahead; older dates (back to 2005) return results and closing odds.

dateTo.title: To date
dateTo.description: Same formats. Empty means the same day as From. Up to 366 days per run.

players.title: Players
players.description: Only matches with these players, e.g. Sinner, Alcaraz, Swiatek. Surname is enough. Empty for all.

includeOdds.title: Odds and head-to-head
includeOdds.description: Average bookmaker odds for each player (closing odds for finished matches), implied probability, favourite, and head-to-head count for fixtures. No extra charge.

includeStats.title: Match stats
includeStats.description: Aces, double faults, 1st serve %, serve and return points won, break points, winners, unforced errors, per match and per set. Finished and live matches within the last 7 days. +$0.002 per match that has stats.

maxMatches.title: Max matches
maxMatches.description: Stop after this many match rows.
